# git-kanban

> Terminal kanban board for GitHub Issues / GitLab Issues.
> 858KB single binary. 4 crates. Zero HTTP deps. Agent-friendly JSON mode.

## Quick start

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/Feahter/git-kanban
# or: cargo install git-kanban
```

## Read issues (JSON)

```bash
git-kanban --json --repo owner/name
git-kanban --json --repo owner/name --cached           # <10ms, no network
git-kanban --json --repo owner/name --column doing       # Filter by column
git-kanban --json --repo owner/name --fields number,title,priority  # Less tokens
git-kanban --summary --repo owner/name                  # Per-column counts
```

## Write operations

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Create | `git-kanban create "title" --label bug --body "desc"` |
| Close  | `git-kanban close 42` |
| Reopen | `git-kanban reopen 42` |
| Comment| `git-kanban comment 42 --body "message"` |
| Assign | `git-kanban assign 42` |
| Move   | `git-kanban move 42 --add-label doing --remove-label todo` |
| Edit   | `git-kanban edit 42 --title "new" --body "new"` |
| Labels | `git-kanban labels` |

## Key features

- **Agent-first**: every read outputs JSON, every write is a deterministic subcommand
- **Dual backend**: GitHub (gh CLI) + GitLab (glab CLI)
- **Lightweight**: 858KB binary, <10ms startup, 4 crates (ratatui, crossterm, serde, clap)
- **Zero async**: no tokio, no HTTP client, no embedded DB
- **Offline-capable**: JSON cache persists across sessions
- **`--dry-run`**: preview operations without side effects (safe for agents)

## TUI mode

```bash
git-kanban --repo owner/name
```

5-column kanban (todo/doing/review/done/closed) with keyboard navigation, priority coloring, inline create/comment/move.

## Configuration

`~/.config/git-kanban/config.json` — set default repo, backend, and custom column labels.

## JSON schema

```json
{
  "repo": "owner/name",
  "backend": "github",
  "from_cache": false,
  "cached_at": "",
  "total": 1,
  "issues": [
    {
      "number": 1,
      "title": "Example issue",
      "body": "Description",
      "state": "Open",
      "labels": ["bug"],
      "assignees": ["user"],
      "priority": "P0",
      "created_at": "2026-07-01T10:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-07-07T12:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```
